summary: Windmill Steering Golf is a hand-drawn mini-golf game where you putt across a pond on a bridge, dodge sand and spinning windmill blades, and sink the ball by the red flag in five strokes or fewer. Aim with Arrows/WASD, hold and release Space to charge your putt, then keep steering the rolling ball by tilting the course with Arrows/WASD — pressing Enter to undo a bad shot.
